dataset: PhysioNet Abdominal and Direct Fetal ECG Database v1.0.0
input_channels: four abdominal ECG leads; direct fetal ECG QRS annotations used only for reference FHR/error
sqi_definition: maximum overlap-corrected normalized autocorrelation over 105-180 bpm lags after 20-100 Hz zero-phase bandpass
piv_definition: clip(0.75 * arithmetic mean of available lead SQIs - 0.25 * mean absolute lead-HR deviation from SQI-weighted consensus / 140 bpm, 0, 1)
claim_boundary: Preliminary association for a multi-electrode ECG adaptation in five recordings
